title: Support-size estimation

problem.name: Support-size estimation
problem.statement_latex: Given a distribution $p$ whose nonzero probabilities are at least $1/m$, estimate $S(p)=|\{i:p_i>0\}|$ to additive error $\varepsilon m$. Access is through the coherent sampler used by Li--Wu.
problem.statement_text: Given a distribution $p$ whose nonzero probabilities are at least $1/m$, estimate $S(p)=|\{i:p_i>0\}|$ to additive error $\varepsilon m$. Access is through the coherent sampler used by Li–Wu.

quantum.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(\sqrt m/\varepsilon^{3/2})$ quantum queries by Li--Wu, using amplitude estimation and polynomial approximations to the zero-probability threshold.
quantum.headline_text: $\widetilde O(\sqrt m/\varepsilon^{3/2})$ quantum queries by Li–Wu, using amplitude estimation and polynomial approximations to the zero-probability threshold.
